runtimeLimitations: V34 adds five oriented clips: hurt right/left, crouch right/left, forward walk left.

Heavy remains review-only because its shoulder check does not match inherited vertical heavy mechanics.

Medium/guard initial hand problems remain rejected.
Other missing states use the already validated V32 idle held pose.

assets.label: crouch

assets.label: guard
notes: Raised blade-gauntlet ends in rails/blades without a readable complete right hand in guard poses. Rejected for hand anatomy; do not approve runtime guard.

assets.label: hurt
notes: Impact, deeper recoil, recovery, neutral; hands and wrist blades visually reviewed.

assets.label: medium
notes: Front kick phases supplied but right hand is not clearly present beyond the blade gauntlet in multiple poses. Recovery also stops at chamber, no grounded final. Requires hand repair and correct phase mapping.

assets.label: heavy
notes: Two distinct forward weight shifts between ready/recovery, complete right hand visible outside blade rails. Actual phases relabeled to reflect received drawings. Gameplay move alignment pending.

assets.label: walk-forward
notes: Contacts 1 and 3 repeat the same near leg forward; left-facing passing poses also repeat same support. No full alternating forward walking cycle. Hands readable; cannot label this a valid walk.
